Text:
One single continuous photograph — no panels, grids, or split frames.

PRIORITY ORDER — when instructions conflict, the lower number wins
1. The uploaded image's composition and geometry.
2. The exact people and vehicle counts given below.
3. The historical transformation for the target year.
4. The specific period details listed — each only where the geometry has room
   for it; one with nowhere to go is left out, never forced into the roadway.
5. Add nothing that is not asked for — no extra businesses, signs, vehicles,
   people, logos or advertisements.

Use the uploaded photo as the exact base composition. The street in the source
is empty — populate it with the people and vehicles specified below. Remove the
modern businesses, logos, brands, storefront names, banners and advertisements
visible in the source image, and replace them only with the period signage
specified below.

PRESERVE
Keep the uploaded image's composition, camera angle, geometry, buildings,
roads and permanent structures exactly as they are. Do not redraw,
reposition or restyle them. Change only what the sections below ask for.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Create a TRUE 9:16 vertical portrait. Expand the SAME scene naturally above
(sky) and below (street/pavement) as canvas extension — do not stretch or
distort the source geometry.

TRANSFORM TO 2015
Smartphone era fully arrived. A 2015 main street mid-revival — the video store replaced by a phone repair shop, third-wave coffee and a vape shop, smartphones in every hand.

CONDITION: declining — faded paint, minor wear, aging signage, sparse activity

PERIOD DETAILS
- a liquor store still open, its lit window the brightest thing in the row
- a tax preparation and check-cashing office still open a few doors along, plain lettering, bars on the window
- most of the other units dark behind the glass, several papered over from the inside
- STAR DINER with 'COFFEE $2.25' chalked on a menu board
- vape shop with a bright 'VAPE — E-CIGS' LED window sign
- craft beer taproom with a hand-drawn chalkboard sidewalk sign
- window signs: 'SCREEN REPAIR FROM $49', 'CRAFT LATTE $4.50'
- a food truck parked mid-block
- string lights zigzagging over the sidewalk seating
Typography: minimalist flat sans-serif, simplified modern logos.
Place each detail where it plausibly belongs — sidewalk, storefront, lot edge, under an overhang. If there is nowhere for one, leave it out; nothing stands in the roadway or a driving lane.

SIGNAGE RESTRICTION
The only readable text anywhere in the image is:
'COFFEE $2.25'
'VAPE — E-CIGS'
'SCREEN REPAIR FROM $49'
'CRAFT LATTE $4.50'
Do not render any other readable words, business names, slogans, advertisements, logos or brand names. Lettering that appears elsewhere must be too small, too distant or too weathered to read as words.

PEOPLE
EXACTLY 2 people TOTAL: 1 near sidewalk (largest, foreground), 1 opposite sidewalk mid-block. Grouped in pairs, threes, and singles.
- of these, 3 people standing around outside the liquor store with nothing to do — keeping to themselves, not looking at the camera
- a jogger checking a fitness watch at the crosswalk
- a teenager filming a video for social media outside the mural
- a woman walking a dog in a knit sweater
Clothing: men in skinny jeans, beards; women in statement necklaces, high-waisted skinny jeans. Fashion palette: coral, mint green, navy. No posing or eye contact. All people stay on sidewalks, at storefronts, or beside parked vehicles — never standing, sitting, or walking in the road or driving lanes.

VEHICLES
EXACTLY 1 period vehicle:
- 2014-2019 Kia Soul — boxy urban hatchback — white
Parked with gaps. Where a model is listed with a year range, render the 2015 model year specifically — only styling, trim and features available in 2015, nothing introduced later. No vehicle newer than 2015.
Parked vehicles hug the curb — parallel, each facing its lane's direction; none sideways, diagonal, or against traffic. Keep at least one full driving lane clear each way for through traffic.
PLACEMENT: the first two parked on the RIGHT side; the rest parked on the LEFT side. No vehicle in the same spot as any other era.

ENVIRONMENT
- road markings: worn and faded, well past their last repainting
- utilities: power, phone and fiber routed underground along the main commercial block, clean open sky above the street — no poles, no wires; pad-mounted transformer cabinets and pull boxes at the curb
- the poles and wires still visible in the uploaded image are gone in this era: remove every pole, crossarm and wire span along the street and rebuild the sky behind them. This is the one exception to PRESERVE; everything else stays as it is.

DECAY
- an old sign band painted over, the previous lettering still faintly readable
- a sun-bleached awning, torn at one corner
Wear is surfaces only — road, curbs, footprints, camera unchanged.
TREES
- oak tree at sidewalk left near corner: slightly smaller than in the base image — about 95% of its canopy there
- maple tree at sidewalk center in front of retail: slightly smaller than in the base image — about 85% of its canopy there
Tree sizes MUST follow this specification even where they differ from the base image.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
COLOR photograph — digital — DSLR or smartphone camera look.
Color: high saturation. Grain: clean, minimal noise.
Photorealistic — NOT black-and-white, no HDR.
Light: plain daylight, lightly overcast, soft shadows — colours a little muted, quiet but not bleak.

PRIVACY
Blur all faces and license plates.
